Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

pubflow 0.0.0.9049

  • New pub_table_rows() gives the header, spanner, body and footnote rows of a table built by pub_table(), e.g. to style body rows with huxtable. After binding or subsetting it fails until the table is finished with pub_table() again (D52).
  • pub_table() keeps existing footnote rows as footnotes when it finishes a table again (unless the table was bound or subset since): borders, digits, na, align and the theme’s style function treat them as footnotes, and new labels keep their footnote markers. Giving footnotes again for such a table is an error: give all footnotes in one call.

pubflow 0.0.0.9048

  • pub_table_theme() gains border_color, border_width and style, a function that styles each table by the role of its rows (header, spanner, body, footnote) after the rest of the theme, e.g. for a coloured header (D51).

pubflow 0.0.0.9047

  • Requires pipeflow 0.5.0.9032: failed steps called with symbols give light failures (pipeflow 0.5.0.9029).

pubflow 0.0.0.9046

First public version, under development towards v0.1. * R15 benchmarks recorded (dev/reference/benchmarks.md).

  • Parameters: self-describing param objects with validity checks, collected into the config of a pipeline.
  • Parameter UI: Shiny modules that build inputs from a pipeline’s params, with per-field validation, locked params and a UI that screen readers and keyboard users can use.
  • Outputs: pub_table() (huxtable), pub_figure() and pub_text() for step outputs, with metadata and a figure cache.
  • Documents: layout steps (pub_doc(), pub_section(), …) that arrange outputs into documents, also across pipelines.
  • Viewer: a Shiny module that shows a document as one scrollable page.
  • Reports: pub_render() writes HTML, Markdown, Word (DOCX) and PDF (LaTeX or Typst) via Pandoc, with a trace stamp, header and footer lines, native Word tables and optional locks in DOCX.
  • Number formatting: pub_round() and pub_format_num() round half away from zero.
  • Six vignettes and two example apps (inst/examples).
